# London Neighborhood Dashboard Plan

A simple dashboard should help compare **cost, commute, and safety** at a glance for Camden, Hackney, Wimbledon, Stratford, and Greenwich. The best layout is a compact KPI strip, one comparison chart for each tradeoff, and a ranked neighborhood view for decision-making.

## Neighborhood Tradeoff View

Phase 1: Core comparison data

| Neighborhood | Rent / month | Commute to central London | Safety score |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Camden | £2,600 | 22 min | 7.8 |
| Hackney | £2,300 | 28 min | 7.1 |
| Wimbledon | £2,400 | 35 min | 8.4 |
| Stratford | £1,950 | 31 min | 6.9 |
| Greenwich | £2,100 | 40 min | 8.0 |

### Best chart types for this dataset

- **Grouped bar chart** for rent and commute side by side by neighborhood
  - Best for quickly comparing magnitude differences
  - Good when users want to scan which places are cheaper or faster

- **Scatter plot** for commute vs safety, with rent as point size or color
  - Best for showing tradeoffs and identifying balanced options
  - Helps reveal neighborhoods that are safer but farther away, or closer but less safe

- **Ranked horizontal bar chart** for safety score
  - Best for clean safety comparison
  - Easy to read because all scores are on the same 0–10 scale

- **Bubble chart** for the full tradeoff picture
  - X-axis: commute minutes
  - Y-axis: rent
  - Bubble color or size: safety score
  - Best single chart if you want one view that combines all three metrics

### Recommended dashboard layout

- **Top row:** 3 KPI cards
  - Lowest rent: **Stratford**
  - Fastest commute: **Camden**
  - Highest safety: **Wimbledon**

- **Middle row:** 2 charts
  - Grouped bar chart: rent + commute
  - Scatter/bubble chart: commute vs safety, with rent encoded

- **Bottom row:** ranked neighborhood list
  - Best value
  - Best commute
  - Best safety
  - Balanced overall choice

## Main Insight

- **Camden** is the strongest **commute-first** option, with the fastest access to central London, but it is not the cheapest.
- **Wimbledon** offers the **best safety score**, but it comes with a longer commute, so it suits users prioritizing comfort over speed.
- **Stratford** is the **lowest-rent** neighborhood, but its safety score is the weakest in this set, making it the clearest budget tradeoff.

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Compare in Bubble Chart](https://www.datawrapper.de/)
- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard](https://www.tableau.com/)
- Action: [Button: Create Charts in Sheets](https://www.google.com/sheets/about/)

## Sources

- London neighborhood comparison data: provided in prompt
- Chart design guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization
- Bubble chart basics: https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/bubble-chart/
